description.text: Measure local memory pressure using the kernel’s available-memory estimate.

warning_help.text: Warn at or above this percentage of used memory.

critical_help.text: Mark critical at or above this percentage of used memory.

invalid_thresholds.text: The critical threshold must be greater than the warning threshold.

usage.1.text: Read a bounded kernel memory snapshot through the agent.

usage.2.text: Compare used memory against the effective thresholds.
